name: io.github.unravel-team/thing
title: thing
description: Artifacts for any coding agent: a durable link with versions, diffs, and comments on the page.

runtimeArguments.description: Run the CLI as a Model Context Protocol server over stdio

environmentVariables.name: THING_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token from usething.ai, under Settings then Tokens. Lets the server publish on your behalf with no terminal login.

environmentVariables.name: THING_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the thing server. Defaults to https://usething.ai; only set this for a self-hosted instance.
